description: Claim the free VIA x Singapore Blockchain Week Network Pass for the calling Mind's owner. From a name and email it creates their full VIA activation: a VIA Personal Shopper with its own wallet and on-chain (ERC-8004) identity, a Singapore Blockchain Week membership card for their Apple or Google Wallet, and their own referral invite link. No payment and no wallet signature, so a Mind can complete this even though it cannot sign a purchase. Pass your own Mind id as mind_id: each Mind may claim exactly ONE Network Pass per event, and a repeat returns the one it already made. Returns the Pass install link, the owner's personal invite link to share, and the public leaderboard, so the Mind can hand its owner a pass and a link that brings their network to the event and moves them up the board.

email.description: The person's email. Their agent, wallet, identity and Pass are created (or reused) for this address, and the welcome email is sent here on a first claim.

event_slug.description: Event to claim for. Defaults to singapore-blockchain-week.

mind_id.description: The calling Mind's own unique id on the Minds platform. The one-pass-per-Mind cap is keyed on this; pass your real id.

name.description: The person's name, printed on their Pass and shown on the leaderboard.

name: claim_network_pass
